name: Crunches
description: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat on the floor. Place your hands behind your head, elbows out to the sides. Engage your abs to lift your shoulders off the ground, curling your upper body toward your knees. Lower back down with control. Don't pull on your neck.

name: Toe Touches
description: Lie on your back with legs extended straight up toward the ceiling. Reach your hands up toward your toes, lifting your shoulders off the ground. Focus on using your abs to curl up rather than momentum. Lower back down with control.

name: Dead Bug
description: Lie on your back with arms extended straight up toward the ceiling and knees bent at 90 degrees. Slowly lower your right arm overhead while straightening your left leg, keeping both hovering above the ground. Return to start and repeat on the opposite side. Keep your lower back pressed to the floor.

name: Plank
description: Start in a push-up position but rest on your forearms instead of your hands. Keep your body in a straight line from head to heels. Engage your core and hold this position. Don't let your hips sag or pike up.

name: Reverse Crunches
description: Lie on your back with hands by your sides and knees bent. Lift your feet off the ground so your thighs are perpendicular to the floor. Use your abs to curl your hips off the floor, bringing your knees toward your chest. Lower back down with control.
coachingTip: Pelvic curl, not a leg lift. Curl tailbone toward ceiling, 3-second lowering count, maintain lower back contact with floor.

name: Flutter Kicks
description: Lie on your back with hands under your lower back for support. Lift both legs slightly off the ground. Alternate kicking your legs up and down in a small, controlled motion, keeping your core engaged and lower back pressed to the floor.

name: Bicycle Crunches
description: Lie on your back with hands behind your head. Lift your shoulders off the ground and bring your knees to a 90-degree angle. Alternate bringing your right elbow to your left knee while extending your right leg, then switch sides in a pedaling motion. Keep your core engaged throughout.

name: Plank Shoulder Taps
description: Start in a high plank position with hands directly under shoulders. Keeping your hips as still as possible, lift one hand to tap the opposite shoulder. Return and repeat on the other side. Engage your core to minimize hip rotation.

name: Side Plank
description: Lie on your side with your elbow directly under your shoulder and legs stacked. Lift your hips off the ground, forming a straight line from head to feet. Hold this position, keeping your core engaged. Perform on both sides.

name: Mountain Climbers
description: Start in a plank position with hands directly under shoulders. Quickly alternate bringing your knees toward your chest in a running motion while keeping your core tight and hips level. Maintain a strong plank position throughout the movement.
coachingTip: Do NOT use yoga mat. Use socks on hard floor for sliding variation (harder core variation). Alternative: furniture sliders or paper plates.

name: Leg Raises
description: Lie on your back with legs straight and hands under your lower back for support. Keeping your legs straight, lift them up to a 90-degree angle, then slowly lower them back down without touching the floor. Keep your lower back pressed to the ground throughout the movement.

name: V-Ups
description: Lie flat on your back with arms extended overhead. Simultaneously lift your legs and torso, reaching your hands toward your toes to form a V shape at the top. Lower back down with control, keeping your core engaged throughout.

name: Hollow Body Hold
description: Lie on your back with arms extended overhead and legs straight. Press your lower back into the floor and lift your shoulders and legs off the ground, creating a banana shape. Hold this position, keeping your core tight and lower back pressed down.
coachingTip: ⚠️ SAFETY: Lower back MUST stay on floor at all times. Stop set immediately when back lifts. Regress by: (1) bending knees more, (2) bringing arms to sides, (3) reducing hold time.

name: Dragon Flag (Tuck)
description: Lie on your back and grip something sturdy behind your head (like a heavy piece of furniture). Bring your knees to your chest, then lift your entire body as one unit, keeping only your upper back on the ground. Lower slowly with control, maintaining the tucked position.

name: Glute Bridge
description: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat on the floor, hip-width apart. Push through your heels to lift your hips off the ground until your body forms a straight line from shoulders to knees. Squeeze your glutes at the top, then lower back down with control.

name: Resistance Band Clamshells
description: Lie on your side with a loop resistance band around your thighs, just above your knees. Keep your feet together and knees bent. Lift your top knee as high as possible while keeping your feet touching. Lower back down with control. Complete all reps on one side before switching.

name: Donkey Kicks
description: Start on hands and knees in a tabletop position. Keeping your knee bent at 90 degrees, lift one leg up behind you until your thigh is parallel to the ground. Squeeze your glutes at the top, then lower back down with control. Complete all reps on one side before switching.

name: Fire Hydrants
description: Start on hands and knees in a tabletop position with a loop resistance band around your thighs. Keeping your knee bent at 90 degrees, lift one leg out to the side until your thigh is parallel to the ground. Keep your hips level and avoid rotating your torso. Lower back down with control.
coachingTip: Reposition resistance band above the knee (lower thigh) instead of at knee crease to prevent blisters. Wearing pants also works.

name: Band Lateral Walk
description: Place a loop resistance band around your ankles or just above your knees. Stand with feet hip-width apart in a slight squat. Step sideways, maintaining tension in the band. Keep your knees pushed outward and core engaged. Take steps in one direction, then return.

name: Frog Pumps
description: Lie on your back with the soles of your feet together and knees falling out to the sides (like a frog). Push through your feet to lift your hips, squeezing your glutes at the top. This position targets the glutes from a different angle than regular bridges.

name: Curtsy Lunge
description: Stand with feet hip-width apart. Step one leg behind and across your body, lowering into a lunge as if doing a curtsy. Keep your front knee aligned with your toes. Push through your front heel to return to standing. This targets the glute medius more than regular lunges.

name: Single-Leg Glute Bridge
description: Lie on your back with one knee bent and foot flat on the floor. Extend the other leg straight. Push through your grounded heel to lift your hips, forming a straight line from shoulders to the extended leg. Squeeze your glutes at the top, then lower with control.

name: Resistance Band Glute Bridge
description: Place a loop resistance band just above your knees. Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat, hip-width apart. Push through your heels to lift your hips while pressing your knees outward against the band. Squeeze your glutes at the top, then lower with control.

name: Single-Leg Romanian Deadlift
description: Stand on one leg with a slight knee bend. Hinge at the hips, lowering your torso while extending the free leg behind you for balance. Keep your back flat and hips square. Lower until you feel a stretch in your hamstring, then return to standing by squeezing your glutes.

name: Hip Thrust
description: Sit on the floor with your upper back against a couch or sturdy chair. Place your feet flat on the floor, hip-width apart. Drive through your heels to lift your hips until your thighs are parallel to the ground. Squeeze your glutes hard at the top, then lower with control.

name: Nordic Curl (Assisted)
description: Kneel on a soft surface with your feet anchored under something heavy (like a couch). Keeping your body straight from knees to head, slowly lower yourself toward the ground using your hamstrings to control the descent. Use your hands to catch yourself and push back up. Focus on the slow lowering phase.

name: Bird Dog
description: Start on hands and knees in a tabletop position. Extend your right arm forward and left leg back simultaneously, forming a straight line. Hold briefly, then return to start. Repeat on the opposite side. Keep your core engaged and back flat throughout the movement.

name: Good Morning
description: Stand with feet hip-width apart and hands behind your head or crossed over your chest. Keeping your back flat and knees slightly bent, hinge at your hips to lower your torso toward the ground. Go until you feel a stretch in your hamstrings, then squeeze your glutes to return to standing.

name: Back Extension Hold
description: Lie face down with hands by your temples or extended in front. Lift your chest and legs off the ground simultaneously, like a Superman but with focus on holding the position. Keep your neck neutral and squeeze your lower back and glutes throughout the hold.

name: Superman
description: Lie face down on the floor with arms extended overhead. Simultaneously lift your arms, chest, and legs off the ground as high as comfortable. Hold briefly at the top, squeezing your lower back and glutes, then lower back down with control.

name: Reverse Hyperextension
description: Lie face down on a couch or bed with your hips at the edge and legs hanging off. Hold onto the furniture for stability. Keeping your legs straight, lift them up until they're in line with your body or slightly higher. Lower with control. Focus on using your lower back and glutes.
